stdio_review.reviewer: current Codex assistant, candidate author and explicit source/algorithm reviewer
stdio_review.algorithm_assessment: Group queries by step and then residue, processing starts in descending order within each residue. Extend the already-summed suffix only over the disjoint gap to the next requested start; repeated starts reuse the sum. A given step scans at most n weights and only residue classes actually queried, while large steps naturally have short tails. Packed unsigned64-bit answers preserve up to3e14 totals, and packed linked query lists plus streaming integer parsing keep memory bounded without a full n-by-sqrt(n) table.
stdio_review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.

stdio_review.reviewer: current Codex assistant, candidate author and explicit source/algorithm reviewer
stdio_review.algorithm_assessment: Run0-1 shortest paths on position plus incoming direction. Empty cells continue straight; a mirror always turns90 degrees and its current orientation costs0 while the other costs1. Walls absorb light and only the other boundary opening is the target. The direction state avoids conflating distinct arrivals. A repeated mirror demanding inconsistent orientations can be shortcut at that mirror to connect the earlier entrance to the later exit with no greater cost, so an optimal state path yields a consistent static mirror placement. Reverse traversal makes either of the two openings a valid starting choice.
stdio_review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
